graphicEarnsIt.says: A measured drawing of the layout the frame itself sits on: six equal columns, each 250 wide, separated by 30 gutters, held off the canvas edge by a 160 margin, with the third column filled to mark the one element being placed. The rulers under the strip carry real quantities, so the picture states the widths and spacings rather than describing them. LEFT's version of the same beat encodes nothing: 100% and an infinity glyph are not measurements of anything, and 8px is a word set large, not a size shown.
